lines.zh: 拉弓如满月，箭雨密不透风！
lines.en: Draws bow like a full moon, rain of arrows!

lines.zh: 黑暗中我狩猎，月光下我静候！
lines.en: I hunt in the dark, wait under moonlight.
Taut bowstring, gaze like a flame.
Black gold land, my bow as witness.
Arrows fly, nowhere to hide.
Moonless night, I move silently.

lines.zh: 箭矢为我指路，黑暗中指引！
lines.en: Arrows lead the way, in the dark.

lines.zh: 黑影中，我是最锐利的剑！
lines.en: In shadows, I'm the sharpest blade.
Bowmaster is my title.
Under moonlight, I dance with the night.
I cross the black gold rubble without a sound.
My quiver shifts. Only three arrows left.

lines.zh: 黑暗中我沉思，静候时机！
lines.en: I meditate in the dark, waiting for the right moment.
Wait for prey, as an arrow on a string.
Bow in hand, I am power.

lines.zh: 夜幕下，我的声音不可闻！
lines.en: Under the night, my voice is inaudible.

lines.zh: 静待敌人的出现，箭矢蓄势待发！
lines.en: Wait for the enemy, arrows ready.

lines.zh: 黑暗中的等待，是最强大的力量！
lines.en: Wait in the dark, the strongest power.
Wait for the moment, piercing two with one.
Silent, my will is iron.

lines.zh: 沉默即是杀机，我是沉默的猎手！
lines.en: Silence is the killer, I am the silent hunter.

lines.zh: 夜色中，我的存在无声无息！
lines.en: In the night, my presence is silent.

lines.zh: 猎物就在眼前，一箭射穿！
lines.en: Prey in sight, one arrow kills.

lines.zh: 感知你的气息，箭矢即至！
lines.en: I sense your presence, arrows come.

lines.zh: 你的身影，我弓下的猎物！
lines.en: Your form, my target under the bow.

lines.zh: 你的出现，只为了我的箭矢！
lines.en: Your arrival, only for my arrow.

lines.zh: 箭矢如影随形，追踪你的踪迹！
lines.en: Arrows follow you, tracking your trail.

lines.zh: 你的气息，我的箭矢锁定！
lines.en: Your scent, my arrow locks on.

lines.zh: 你的动作，我箭矢的引线！
lines.en: Your movements, the arrow's trigger.

lines.zh: 瞄准你，我不会轻易失手！
lines.en: Aiming at you, I will not miss.

lines.zh: 你的存在，我箭下的牺牲！
lines.en: Your existence, my arrow's offering.
Sense you, one arrow away!

lines.zh: 你的膝盖露在护甲外面。
lines.en: Your knee shows below the armor.

lines.zh: 你的步幅我一眼就量出来。
lines.en: I measure your stride at a glance.

lines.zh: 我的羽箭射穿了你的皮甲！
lines.en: My arrow pierced through your mail!
An arrow hit my arm...

lines.zh: 我失去了另一块盾板碎片...
lines.en: I lost another shield fragment...
An arrow took a chunk out of my armor...
My longbow is damaged...

lines.zh: 我的箭矢在你身上留下伤痕...
lines.en: My arrows leave scars on you...
I lost my quiver...
My long boots fell off...
I took some damage...
You punched me...

lines.zh: 我看到了你，美味的人肉！
lines.en: I see you, tasty morsel!

lines.zh: 你属于这片黑金之地吗？
lines.en: Do you belong here, in the Black Gold?
Come, let my arrows claim you.

lines.zh: 你是唯一的机会，抓住它。
lines.en: You're the only chance, take it.

lines.zh: 我的箭矢比你的梦想更真实。
lines.en: My arrows are more real than your dreams.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，只有我才能指引你。
lines.en: Only I can guide you in the darkness.

lines.zh: 你将成为我战利品的一部分。
lines.en: You will be part of my spoils.

lines.zh: 你的命运，就在我的箭尖。
lines.en: Your fate is on my arrow.

lines.zh: 选择死亡，比选择恐惧更简单。
lines.en: Choose death over fear.

lines.zh: 黑夜给了我黑色的眼睛，我用它射你。
lines.en: The night gave me black eyes, and I use them on you.

lines.zh: 我的弓弦如闪电般疾射。
lines.en: My bowstring shoots like lightning.
You stand between me and freedom.
Escape the arrows of fate.

lines.zh: 我的存在，就是你的障碍。
lines.en: My presence is your obstacle.

lines.zh: 退后，否则我会用箭射你。
lines.en: Back away, or I'll shoot you.
You cannot stop my attack.

lines.zh: 让我的箭矢成为你的终结者。
lines.en: Let my arrows be your end.

lines.zh: 我的箭瞄的是你的膝盖。
lines.en: My arrow is aimed at your knee.
My arrows never lie.

lines.zh: 我的箭总往你的膝盖去。
lines.en: My arrows always find your knee.
My companion, hunt together.
Find someone worth loving.
Share your prey.
We are hunters of the night.
Let's weave our destinies together.
Your courage attracts me.

lines.zh: 共同面对黑金之地的挑战。
lines.en: Face the challenges of the Black Gold together.

lines.zh: 黑金世界的风沙里，也得有个伴。
lines.en: Even in the Black Gold sands, one needs a companion.
Seek the light in the darkness.
Travel through the night with me.

lines.zh: 拾起了箭矢，身体微微晃动。
lines.en: Picks up an arrow, shivering.
Stares at the bow, eyes sharp.
Draws an arrow from the quiver.

lines.zh: 轻盈地从地上捡起一根箭。
lines.en: Gently picks up an arrow from the ground.

lines.zh: 手指在弦上划过，发出轻微的响声。
lines.en: Flicks a finger across the string, a soft sound.
A cold glint in the eyes.
Raises the bow, ready to shoot.

lines.zh: 箭矢被拉满，几乎触到下巴。
lines.en: The arrow is fully drawn, nearly touching the chin.
Targets the enemy, focused eyes.
The arrow flies, heading for the target.
Acquires target, locks on quickly.

lines.zh: 目光如炬，瞄准远处的敌人。
lines.en: Gaze intense, targets the distant enemy.
Ears up, locking on the prey.
Staring at the enemy, motionless.

lines.zh: 追踪目标，箭矢即将发射。
lines.en: Tracking the target, ready to shoot.
Scanning for a new target.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，箭矢蓄势待发。
lines.en: Target locked, arrow at the ready.
Targeting, confirming the aim.

lines.zh: 膝盖中箭，是这里的规矩。
lines.en: An arrow in the knee — house rules.

lines.zh: 目光锁定，箭矢即将发射。
lines.en: Locked target, arrow ready.

lines.zh: 一百四十点生命，慢慢陪。
lines.en: A hundred and forty health. I can take my time.
A dry branch snapped under your foot.
The black gold world offers no cover.
The wind died. Now the shot is true.
Aim, the arrow a crescent moon.
Aim at the enemy, one arrow, one hit.
Precise aim, one shot, one kill.
Aim, targeting the enemy’s throat.
Aim, arrow like a meteor.
Aim, precise without fail.
Aim, arrow slicing through the air.
Aim, precise strike.
Aim, arrow following like a shadow.
Aim, arrow into the heart.

lines.zh: 十六点伤害，够你记住了。
lines.en: Sixteen damage. You will remember it.
I count the gaps between your breaths.
Full draw, hold, release.
Your left shoulder sits lower than the right.
Next shot, half a notch higher.
Piercing your chest with an arrow!
My arrows will not miss!
Feel the pain of twilight!

lines.zh: 你的盔甲挡不住我的箭！
lines.en: My arrows pierce through armor!
Hitting your bones!
You cannot evade my sneak attack!
Arrows raining down, nowhere to hide!

lines.zh: 我的箭矢将你的生命夺走！
lines.en: My arrows take your life!
You cannot escape my aim!
Let the twilight arrow end you!
This one? Right in the knee.
The arrow glances off armor in a spark.
Raise the shield. I shoot your feet.

lines.zh: 箭尾还在颤，人已经倒了。
lines.en: The fletching still quivers as you fall.
I step back three paces and fire again.
An arrow in twilight is colder than night.
Darkness calls me to emerge!
Emerging from twilight's glow!
Silently arriving in the darkness!
Twilight world is my home!
I emerge as the night falls!
Emerging in the twilight!
The night is proof of my existence!
Twilight world is my home!
Emerging in the shadows!

lines.zh: 从黑金世界的沙里站起来，弓还在。
lines.en: I rise from the Black Gold sand, bow still in hand.

lines.zh: 黑金之地的风，把我送来。
lines.en: The wind of the black gold land carries me in.
Bow strung. I hold this ground.
Flames burned my skin!

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来受伤了...
lines.en: I fell from a height...
My armor was drenched...
The explosion shook my body...
I was hit by a rock projectile...
A magic attack injured me...
I'm starving, my strength decreases...

lines.zh: 这一箭的账，雷替我算了吗。
lines.en: Did the lightning settle the score for my arrow?

lines.zh: 坠入虚无空间让我受了伤...
lines.en: Falling into the void injured me...
